project.title: The Last Prophecy
project.description: Medieval references meet distressed typography and intricate ornament. The Last Prophecy explores a single visual language through crimson, muted pink and green, and weathered metallic tones.

studio.heading: A distinct point of view.
studio.body: Braho Studio explores the space between historical imagery and contemporary graphic design. Expressive typography, intricate symbols, and tactile surfaces come together in work with a strong visual character.
